skip_reason: Fabrik-Codek requires a running Ollama LLM server (localhost:11434) for all non-trivial operations including fabrik_ask, fabrik_search, fabrik_graph_search, and the full initialization pipeline (fabrik init, fabrik graph build, fabrik rag index, fabrik profile build, fabrik competence build). Running Ollama with any usable model (e.g., qwen2.5-coder:7b at ~4GB) requires GPU access or impractically heavy CPU resources incompatible with a text-only Docker sandbox. Additionally, the SKILL.md explicitly classifies the tool as 'instruction-only' with no automated installer — the fabrik binary must be manually cloned from GitHub and installed, and no offline/mock execution path is documented. This violates both the 'Host-level hardware access (GPUs)' ban and the 'Incomplete/Stub Documentation' ban (the skill admits it is instruction-only with no executable code in the skill itself).
